provenance.dipole_convention: sum_A Z_A R_A - Tr(D M), M_ab = <a|q|b>; PySCF dip_moment(unit=AU)
provenance.placements: ROUND 4 OPUS section 5: NH3 beta from cos^2 b = (2 cos HNH + 1)/3; CH4 d = r/sqrt(3)

appended.response: RPA: tdscf.rhf.TDHF, singlet, nstates 8, conv_tol 1e-12.  TDA: DENSE eigh(A) -- PySCF's TDA Davidson returned residuals (0.0017...0.0081) for benzene's six lowest degenerate roots; `tda_davidson` keeps that unconverged reading for the record.
appended.key: molecules_extended (NOT molecules: tests/rhf-molecules.test.mjs pins the six-key list and runs RHF on every entry of it)
appended.note: the six records under `molecules` are fix-mol6.py's, unchanged; C2H4 and C6H6 carry rpa/tda blocks the six do not

provenance.bse_widened: 2026-09-12: the vendored STO-3G record went from H, Li-F (db98a404...) to H-Kr (elements 1-36, 22ce59b9...) so lab/molecules.js could reach Na-Kr.  The H and Li-F electron_shells are BYTE-IDENTICAL decimals in both records, so every energy under `molecules` and `molecules_extended` is unchanged and was re-proved against the engine after the swap (tests/rhf-molecules.test.mjs, 1e-9).  fix-mol6.py and fix-mol8.py assert the OLD hash and will refuse to re-run until it is edited in them -- that refusal is correct: the record did change.

library.geometry_source: lab/molecules.js, dumped by node inside this script -- every geometry and charge comes from there and from nowhere else; each record carries the entry's own `source` string verbatim
library.geometry_role: experimental-fixed, except AlH3 (this repo's RHF/STO-3G scan, see library_alh3_scan) and the stated idealisations inside individual `source` strings
library.rpa: tdscf.rhf.TDHF, singlet, nstates 5, conv_tol 1e-10, for every entry with nao <= 20; `refused` where A - B is not positive definite (CuH and ZnH2 -- the RHF reference is not a minimum)

cost_model.machine: node 22.22.1 on the λWAVES workstation (Linux 7.0.0-31-generic, RTX 3070 box); the browser worker measured 0.94× the node figure on benzene (9.5 s against 10.1 s)
cost_model.fit: non-negative least squares over all 54 measured entries; worst |ratio| 1.36 above 100 ms, 2.9 below it (where the absolute error is single-digit milliseconds)

rejected.why: worst 4.63× above 100 ms, and it puts Br₂ (7410 predicted, 4005 measured) ABOVE C₆H₆ (5972 predicted, 10053 measured) — nAO³ cannot see the occupation, and the pair space is where benzene's time goes

second_solution.name: core-guess second aufbau RHF solution
second_solution.note: aufbau-obeying, Tr(DS) = 14, pi_u degeneracy broken; 0.7298 hartree above the ground state
